fields.what: Vectors in three dimensions with their laws, the quantity Angle (radian, degree, turn), the axes and the tolerance

rejected.Up as the second axis, as three.js has i: a body on the floor would be measured by its depth; a drawing turns the axes at its own edge
rejected.Left-handed axes: the cross product would point down, and every rule that turns a direction would change sign

rejected.Exact equality: a point computed two ways differs in its last digits
rejected.A millimetre: two hands a millimetre apart would be one, which a figure drawn close up shows

none.meaning: The coordinate of the origin along each axis: no distance

laws.says: Adding is commutative and associative, the origin adds nothing, the difference undoes it
The dot product is symmetric, distributes over addition, and gives a vector's length squared
The cross product is perpendicular to both its factors, and changes sign when they swap
A unit has a length of one and the direction it came from, or is the origin when there was none
A direction makes no angle with itself, a half turn with its opposite, a quarter turn with what it crosses
The axes are right-handed, and forward turned by a quarter turn on the floor is left
Mixing goes from the first at none of the way to the second at all of it, through their middle

fields.context: Poselia's body computed with vectors through helpers written beside its rules, and its angles as numbers of degrees: the next product drawing or moving something would have written them again, and a degree passed where a radian was expected would have been seen by nobody.
fields.consequences: A point, a direction, a key of a pose is a Vector: frozen into a program as it is, compared within the tolerance. A rule receives Vectors as a dependency and calls its operations; an angle is a quantity, written in the unit it is thought in (deg(30), turns(0.25)).

rejected.A class with methods: a value of the graph must be data, which a program carries frozen and a document shows
rejected.three.js's Vector3: the rules of a body would depend on the library that draws it
rejected.Angles as numbers of degrees: a computation in radians and a value in degrees would mix without a word
